283573013.description:
Vintage Hemingray-42 Aqua Glass Telephone Pole Insulator w/ Iron Peg
Vintage Hemingray glass telegraph/telephone pole insulator in aqua/teal blue color. Features embossed 'HEMINGRAY-42' lettering and beaded skirt design around the base. Includes original wrought iron pole mounting peg/pin with wood-covered threaded shaft, used to attach the insulator to utility poles. Both pieces show age-appropriate wear consistent with antique railroad/telegraph line hardware, including surface rust on the iron peg and natural glass wear with embedded dirt. Authentic antique collectible pairing a Hemingray glass insulator with its matching iron pin. Popular among insulator and telegraphiana collectors.
10 x 4 x 4 in
